records.title: Medications and Health: It's Not All About Drugs
records.header: PHARM 301 Medications and Health: It's Not All About Drugs (3) SSc/NSc
records.text: PHARM 301 Medications and Health: It's Not All About Drugs (3) SSc/NSc Covers personal health promotion, treatment of illness, and health care. Explores several medication-related topics, provides insight on drug development and efficacy, and serves as introduction to students contemplating careers in health sciences, especially in pharmacy. Credit/no-credit only.

records.title: Drugs, Diseases, and the Quest for Better Health Outcomes
records.header: PHARM 311 Drugs, Diseases, and the Quest for Better Health Outcomes (3) NSc
records.text: PHARM 311 Drugs, Diseases, and the Quest for Better Health Outcomes (3) NSc Introduces students to the broad principles of how medications produce their effects, how drugs are developed and reach the market, and the landscape of pharmacy practice in the U.S. Recommended: basic knowledge of general chemistry; anatomy; and physiology. Offered: jointly with PHRMSC 311.

records.title: Principles of Pharmacology
records.text: PHARM 401 Principles of Pharmacology (2) NSc Covers fundamental mechanisms of therapeutic drug action in both health and disease. Key topics include how therapeutics interact with the body, routes of medicine administration, and the basics of major therapeutic classes. Prerequisite: either CHEM 223, CHEM 237, or CHEM 257; recommended: one of the following: (1) BIOC 405 and BIOC 406; (2) BIOC 440; BIOC 441; and BIOC 442; (3) BIOL 355; (4) coursework in cell biology. Offered: jointly with PHRMSC 401; A.

records.title: Undergraduate Research
records.text: PHARM 499 Undergraduate Research (1-6, max. 24) Research problems in clinical pharmacy or pharmaceutical sciences, including preclinical and/or clinical drug development and effectiveness research, and participate in departmental research projects. Prerequisite: permission of instructor Offered: AWSpS.
